quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.title: Above the Clouds
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.summar: The moon's lid is gone. The pilgrim is coming down from above the sky.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.done: The bell of the pilgrim gate rang. A road goes on beyond the clouds.
The moon's core stopped, yet the moon did not stop falling, and a winged shadow crossed it. The counting song must go on. Ask the storyteller.
Ask the storyteller about the song
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.ascend: The seventh verse is a song of the sky above. Touch the gate atop the bell tower. The sleeping titans are awake.
Touch the gate atop the great bell tower
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.bell.j: The titans carried you above the clouds. Under the broken pilgrim gate, a single bell remains.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.bell.b: Ring the bell of the pilgrim gate
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fin_verse:
...Did you hear it? That sound of wings.
The counting song's seventh verse. The last one. Even my grandmother sang this part quietly.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fin_verse2:
"Seventh: open your eyes, and choose of the two."
Open your eyes and choose one of two, it says. It never sings what you choose.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fin_verse3: Go to the gate atop the bell tower. ...The great ones who slept have been looking at the sky since last night. They're waiting for you, I'd say.
message.skyabyss.cloudsea.fell: You nearly fell beneath the clouds, and found yourself back on the island.
message.skyabyss.cloudsea.gate: The bell's sound carried far across the sea of clouds.
message.skyabyss.cloudsea.arrive.title: The Cloud Sea
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.title: The Isle of Bells
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.summary: A fragment of the former city floats above the clouds.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.done: The bellkeeper's shadow returned to the sound of the bell.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.walk.jou: From the north of the pilgrim gate's isle, a white bridge climbs above the clouds.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.bells.jo: A street you know. The former city. Three bells remain on the fragments around it. When a bell rings, the nearby clouds turn solid.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.bells.w: Ring the bell on the west fragment
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.bells.e: Ring the bell on the east fragment
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.bells.n: Ring the bell on the northwest fragment
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.door.jou: Three bells have rung. The door of the broken bell tower in the north answered with a dull toll.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.lord.jou: Someone stands atop the bell tower, carrying a bell.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.lord.lor: Lay the last bellkeeper to rest
message.skyabyss.isle1.bell.w: The bell at the ruined chapel rang.
message.skyabyss.isle1.door.shut: The door won't move. The bells on the fragments have not rung yet.
message.skyabyss.isle1.echo.w: Someone's last words remained at the ruined chapel.
message.skyabyss.isle1.echo.e: Someone's last words remained at the market stall.
message.skyabyss.isle1.echo.n: Someone's last words remained by the well.
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_1.title: The Chapel Apprentice
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_1.body:
On the morning the sky turned white, the apprentice kept ringing the bell. The master said, "No one will come, however you ring."

The apprentice did not stop. Not for anyone coming, but to tell the sky that a city had been here.

Even when the clouds rose to their feet, the bell's sound hardened the clouds and kept the apprentice standing to the end.
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_2.title: The Market Seller
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_2.body:
The market seller opened the stall on the last day too, not knowing what to sell to what came down from the sky.

"I feel there was a morning like this before," a customer said. The seller laughed and handed over an apple at the usual price.

The last line of the ledger is blank. The sky came before it could be written.
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_3.title: The Well Keeper
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_3.body:
The well keeper looked up at the sky with the bucket still lowered, and saw the shadow of wings pass over the clouds.

"The bellkeeper climbed the tower with the bell on his back. He never came down."

There is still water at the bottom of the well, though no one draws it.
message.skyabyss.isle1.lord_silence: The bellkeeper raises a hand to its mask, and the bells fall silent; the cloud ring unravels. Ring the small bells around you to firm it again.
message.skyabyss.isle1.lord_wave: The bell wave caught your feet. Jump as the ring passes.
message.skyabyss.isle1.lord_crumble: Half the floor crumbles into cloud.
message.skyabyss.isle1.lord_down: The last bellkeeper's great bell slowly falls silent. Every bell on the island answers it, once.
